title: Austria Faces Twin Pressures as Inflation Rebounds and Headscarf Ban Ignites… · 18 Sep
keywords: Austria, inflation, cost of living, headscarf ban, religious freedom, Austrian National Bank, eurozone, ECB, integration policy, constitutional court, EU politics, consumer prices, wage bargaining, Muslim community, civil rights
notes: Austria is confronting two interlocking crises as the new political season opens: a re-acceleration of consumer price inflation to 3.2 percent in August 2026 and a fiercely contested school-year ban on headscarves for girls under 14. Both issues are exposing deep fault lines between government reassurances and public frustration. The combination is sharpening political polarisation and drawing scrutiny from EU institutions and civil-rights observers alike.
